scope: Prospective SFT save/completion integrity; no historical outcome changes or GPU submission

native_source.finding: Native save catches sampler-write exceptions and continues to write the latest-step pointer. File existence alone does not prove complete sampler state.

corrections: Reopen the two small trusted sampler/trainer metadata files before recording a checkpoint; require their saved counters to match the completed optimizer step.
Require matching final save and validation receipt digests, plan and step for completed runs as well as planned pauses; reject symlink receipts and a wrong saved checkpoint path.
Keep full checkpoint hashing and GPU reload as separate handoff gates.

pre_fix_reproduction.boundary: training_result with real temporary files and deliberately invalid receipts
pre_fix_reproduction.finding: The old code accepted invalid completed-run receipts and some invalid paused-run bindings.

native_cpu.boundary: Actual pinned native checkpoint writer/metadata reader and training loop; synthetic CPU data and GPU dispatch substitutes, not a real GPU training run

preceding_check.qualification_limit: The reused command selected RL/GLM regressions, not the new SFT tests; V5 explicitly added SFT and watchdog tests. V4 alone does not qualify this fix.

remaining_gates: real Miles and SkyRL RL reward/update/checkpoint/recovery
